<meta name="course.sales-pitch" content="<p class="abstract" style="text-align: justify;">With this business degree you will be equipped with skills that meet the demands of business including developing communication and engagement skills, building networks, adopting a commercial mindset, understanding project management and mastering critical thinking and problem solving.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Most businesses around the world now support their critical business processes by using IT. This is as true for large multinationals as it is for small and medium enterprises. Businesses also must use a range of electronic methods in the marketing of products and keeping in touch with clients and employees in an efficient and cost effective ways.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Knowledge of these systems and integrating them into the overall business strategy are essential, together with the use of the data they generate. This <a href="https://www.jcu.edu.sg/courses-and-study/courses/business" target="_blank">business course</a> (majoring in Business Intelligence and Information Systems) provides students with the opportunity to gain these skills as a component of their business studies.</p>">

<meta name="course.subjects" content="<h3 style="border: 0px">Course Structure</h3><div style="border: 0px">4 subjects in Trimester</div><h3>Study Program</h3><div>Students are required to complete 24 subjects.</div><h3 style="border: 0px">Core Subjects</h3><ul><li>Accounting for Decision Making</li><li>Principles of Economics</li><li>Principles of Data Analysis for Business</li><li>Introduction to Management Concepts and Application</li><li>Professional and Academic Skills for Business</li><li>Marketing Matters</li><li>Business Law</li><li>Career Development for Business Professionals</li><li>The Future of Work: Seminar Series</li><li>plus one of the following Work Integrated Learning Capstone Subjects: <ul><li>Professional Internship*</li><li>Multidisciplinary Project</li><li>Independent Project*</li></ul></li><p style="margin-top:0.25em; font-size:0.8em; font-style:italic">*where applicable</p></ul><p><strong>Additional Course Conditions:</strong></p><p>In the JCU Bachelor of Business, students conclude their studies with a core Work Integrated Learning (WIL) experience that connects them with the business community, enabling them to demonstrate their graduate skills to potential employers.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">To be eligible to apply for WIL, students must successfully complete prescribed online career development modules and quizzes throughout the degree to better prepare them for their WIL experience.</p><h3 style="margin-bottom:0em">Business Intelligence and Information Systems</h3><p style="margin-top:0">(8 subjects)</p><ul><li>Problem Solving and Programming I</li><li>Network Security</li><li>Information Processing and Visualisation</li><li>Database Modelling</li><li>Collective Intelligence and Entrepreneurship</li><li>Cloud Computing</li><li>Data Mining</li><li>Information Security</li></ul><p>Note: Upon recommendation students are required to complete English for Academic Purposes subject to meet progression requirements.</p><hr /><p>Total Credit Points: 72</p><p>For a comprehensive listing and&nbsp;outline of the respective course subjects and assessment details, please click <a target="_blank" href="https://handbook.jcu.edu.au/" style="padding: 0px;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px"><strong style="padding: 0px">here</strong></a>.</p>">
<meta name="course.course-learning-outcomes" content="">
<meta name="course.prerequisities" content="<h3 style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;">Entry Requirements</h3><ul style="text-align: justify;"><li>The entry requirements differ from country to country but in general applicants must have satisfactorily completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent</li><li>Successfully complete ten (10) subjects with a minimum pass of 50% per subject and secure an overall 65% of the James Cook University Foundation program will also satisfy the entry requirement.</li></ul><p style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;"><em style="border: 0px">For further information email&nbsp;<a href="mailto:admissions-singapore@jcu.edu.au" style="border: 0px">admissions-singapore@jcu.edu.au</a></em></p><h3 style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;">English Requirements</h3><ul style="text-align: justify;"><li>Applicants of non-English speaking backgrounds must meet the English language proficiency requirements of IELTS 6 (no component lower than 6.0) / TOEFL (Internet Based) 74 (no component less than 18) / Pearson PTE Academic 52 (no component less than 52); or</li><li>Satisfactory completion of James Cook University Singapore&nbsp;<a href="https://www.jcu.edu.sg/courses-and-study/courses/course/english-language-preparatory-program-elpp" target="_blank" style="border: 0px">English Language Preparatory Program (ELPP);</a> or</li><li style="list-style-type:disc" aria-level="1">Successful completion of other qualifications completed in English Language deemed comparable to Australian standards on a case-by-case basis in accordance to JCU admissions guidelines.</li></ul><h3 style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;">Advanced Standing</h3><ul style="text-align: justify;"><li>Advanced standing of up to 8 subjects will be granted upon successful completion of James Cook University&nbsp;<a href="https://www.jcu.edu.sg/courses-and-study/courses/course/diploma-of-higher-education-business-studies" target="_blank" style="border: 0px">Diploma of Higher Education (Business Studies)&nbsp;</a>program.</li><li>Credit exemption may be granted for students with tertiary qualifications from recognised institutions on a case-by-case basis.</li></ul><h3 style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;">Attendance Requirements</h3><p style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;">International students holding a valid Student's Pass are required to attend at least 90% of scheduled classes per month. Failure to attend classes is a breach of the student visa conditions. Being absent from classes for a continuous period of seven days or more, or attendance falling below 90% without valid reasons will result in the student needing to surrender their Student's Pass for cancellation.</p><p style="border: 0px; text-align: justify;">Domestic students must attend at least 75% of the scheduled lecture and tutorial activities to be eligible for assessment.</p>">
<meta name="course.career-outcomes" content="<p>Business graduates with this major can pursue a broad range of careers including business analyst, e-business manager, information systems manager, security analyst, security consultant, system analyst, information system consultant or project manager.</p>">

            <h2>Course overview</h2>
                        <div class="coursedetails__intro"><p class="abstract" style="text-align: justify;">With this business degree you will be equipped with skills that meet the demands of business including developing communication and engagement skills, building networks, adopting a commercial mindset, understanding project management and mastering critical thinking and problem solving.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Most businesses around the world now support their critical business processes by using IT. This is as true for large multinationals as it is for small and medium enterprises. Businesses also must use a range of electronic methods in the marketing of products and keeping in touch with clients and employees in an efficient and cost effective ways.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">Knowledge of these systems and integrating them into the overall business strategy are essential, together with the use of the data they generate. This <a href="https://www.jcu.edu.sg/courses-and-study/courses/business" target="_blank">business course</a> (majoring in Business Intelligence and Information Systems) provides students with the opportunity to gain these skills as a component of their business studies.</p></div>

font-size:0.8em; font-style:italic">*where applicable</p></ul><p><strong>Additional Course Conditions:</strong></p><p>In the JCU Bachelor of Business, students conclude their studies with a core Work Integrated Learning (WIL) experience that connects them with the business community, enabling them to demonstrate their graduate skills to potential employers.</p><p style="text-align: justify;">To be eligible to apply for WIL, students must successfully complete prescribed online career development modules and quizzes throughout the degree to better prepare them for their WIL experience.</p><h3 style="margin-bottom:0em">Business Intelligence and Information Systems</h3><p style="margin-top:0">(8 subjects)</p><ul><li>Problem Solving and Programming I</li><li>Network Security</li><li>Information Processing and Visualisation</li><li>Database Modelling</li><li>Collective Intelligence and Entrepreneurship</li><li>Cloud Computing</li><li>Data Mining</li><li>Information Security</li></ul><p>Note: Upon recommendation students are required to complete English for Academic Purposes subject to meet progression requirements.</p><hr><p>Total Credit Points: 72</p><p>For a comprehensive listing and outline of the respective course subjects and assessment details, please click <a target="_blank" href="https://handbook.jcu.edu.au/" style="padding: 0px;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px"><strong style="padding: 0px">here</strong></a>.</p>
